newsitem.title: USA: First Union, Covenant in merger pact.
newsitem.headline: First Union, Covenant in merger pact.

text.p: First Union Corp will purchase Covenant Bancorp for about $78 million in common stock, the two companies said Tuesday.
Under the terms of the definitive merger agreement, First Union would exchange 0.3813 shares of its common stock for each common share of Covenant.
First Union said it expects the acquisition to be non-dilutive to its earnings on a cumulative basis within 18 months of closing.
The company will account for the deal as a purchase.

In addition, the companies said each share of the two issues of Covenant convertible preferred stock would be exchanged for a number of shares of First Union common stock equal to the respective conversion ratio of the preferred stock, times the merger exchange ratio.
The merger exchange ratio represents 2.52 times Covenant book value as of June 30.
The companies said they expect to complete the acquisition in early 1998.
Covenant of Haddonfield, N.J., is the $454 million-asset holding company for Covenant Bank, a commercial bank, which operates 16 offices in five Southern New Jersey counties.
First Union operates 53 offices in Southern New Jersey and 317 overall in New Jersey. Covenant Bank's operations will be merged into First Union's South Jersey area.
